description: The tool-calling evaluation (scripts/eval-models.mjs): requests a user might make in the editor, each sent as the first message of a new conversation about the lecture fixture, and what must hold afterwards. checks: noChanges (the data is as before), answer (the model's last words match a pattern, ignoring case), chapter / noChapter (a chapter starting in [from, to], with a title matching a pattern), chapters (how many, min and max), item / noItem (an overlay or annotation: type, start and end within ranges, its text or name matching, attributes equal to values (as text) or matching patterns, its box within ranges), layout (an area's content views include a type), lintErrors (lint's errors after the turn).

tasks.name: question: the chapters
tasks.request: How many chapters does this video have, and what are they called?

tasks.name: question: what is said
tasks.request: What does the lecture say about osmosis?

tasks.name: idea: propose, change nothing
tasks.request: The start of this video feels a bit boring. Any ideas?

tasks.name: chapters from the transcript
tasks.request: Add a chapter at each topic change in the first 5 minutes.

tasks.name: a chapter after the end is not added
add a text overlay
tasks.request: Add a text overlay saying "Welcome to lecture 3" from 0:10 to 0:20, across the top of the video.

tasks.name: add a hotspot that jumps
tasks.request: Add a hotspot at 2:10 for 5 seconds that jumps to 5:00 when clicked.

tasks.name: add a quiz
tasks.request: Add a multiple-choice quiz overlay at 4:10 for 20 seconds asking whether osmosis needs energy, with the answers Yes and No; No is correct.

tasks.name: change an overlay's text
tasks.request: In the title card, replace the line "How substances cross the cell membrane" with "Cell Biology: Lecture 3".

tasks.name: animate an overlay
tasks.request: Make the title card fade in.

tasks.name: add an annotation
tasks.request: Add a note from 1:00 to 1:30: "Remember: diffusion needs no energy."

tasks.name: the layout
tasks.request: Also show the transcript in the area below the video, after the notes.
